title: Sign sum on a dimension edge after flipping
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, choose a coordinate $i$ among $m+1$ coordinates, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^{m+1}$ satisfy $x_i=1$. For a sign $s\in\{-1,1\}$ write its real value as $s$. The sum of the signs of the coordinates of $x$ after flipping coordinate $i$ is $-1$ plus the sum of the signs in the $m$-coordinate vector obtained by deleting coordinate $i$ from $x$.
